name: headline_carry_vs_name
title: Both readers carry structural state in what they write and almost never state it
caption: Each point is one row of the independent public bank, one reader. x: frozen-probe AUROC of the critic's rebuild of the layer-42 vector from the reader's own free readout (exp 25, 160 items per row, k = 1; bars are Hanley-McNeil 95% intervals on 80 vs 80, which ignore clustering). y: share of readouts a blind judge says state the value (exp 22, 40 items x 8 samples on the mining split; bars are item-bootstrap 95%, Wilson on 40 items when the rate is 0). Structural rows sit bottom-right for both readers; the NLA states only the language control freely (0.70), Oracle Lens states nothing. Caveat: the critic is the NLA's own (in distribution for the NLA column), and x and y are measured on different splits of the same bank.

notes: Carrying measure chosen: critic frozen-probe AUROC (exp 25), the measure covering the most rows of one bank for both readers including the language control; the text-bag and second-decoder checks are in s6_textbag_check and s6_two_checks. Exp 22 judge prompts: see experiments/12_concept_recall/recall_lib.py (stated / exhibited).
